candidate_and_action_contract.action_visible_fields: question plus the source-provided query-local table and text distractor context only;metadata type modalities entities intermediate answers answers supporting_context qid and source IDs are forbidden

atomic_nodes.ROW: one source table row serialized with table title table name header names cell texts and link titles but no source ID
atomic_nodes.TEXT: one source text paragraph serialized with title and text but no source ID

candidate_and_action_contract.candidate_visibility: the identical label-free closure is visible to E0 E5 RAW and HippoRAG

closure.anchor_models: frozen all-MiniLM-L6-v2 cosine plus frozen ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder
closure.rules: retain all source-provided text nodes up to the fixed cap;retain query-ranked rows;then add query-anchored exact row-cell-link to text-title-or-URL edges and their reverse edges without reading support

proof_bundles.totality_boundary: the preregistered exact-support population requires at least one exact row-text link;within that population every candidate bundle is connected only by source structural links and no inferred fallback edge exists

candidate_and_action_contract.substantive_novelty: query-local typed proof closure and connected row-text evidence-bundle search over exact structural links;not RRF keyword matching prompt rules thresholding candidate deletion or a free-form planner

comparators.HippoRAG: pinned official core in a fresh isolated per-query index over exactly the same closure nodes;index and retrieve only;network denied;complete top-five unique atomic-node ranking
comparators.RAW: the same frozen local cross-encoder directly ranks every identical closure node from the original question without graph edges bundles learned energy or typed proof search
comparators.compute_claim: pipeline-utility comparison only;not equal-compute full-corpus SOTA

evaluator_contract.E0: fixed unsupervised proof energy over complete connected row-text bundles using frozen relevance link consistency coverage redundancy and path-length weights

E5.fit: one deterministic conditional log-linear maximum-entropy model over every sealed valid bundle for all A_form items;multiple exact gold bundles use log-sum-exp marginal likelihood;L2=1;L-BFGS max_iter=256
E5.policy: rank bundles by learned structured proof energy then project the best-bundle-first deterministic ordering to a unique top-five atomic-node ranking

feature_groups: node MiniLM cosine and cross-encoder relevance
connectedness topology coverage redundancy cardinality and path length
evaluator_contract.five_fold_A_form_OOF: HMAC component-disjoint folds audit the unchanged algorithm only;they do not tune choose reject or replace E5

exact_support_population.gold_row_derivation_late_only: union of zero-based rows named by all answer table_indices rows with rows containing an exact canonical cell-link title-or-URL to a gold supporting text;require one to four rows
exact_support_population.gold_text_derivation_late_only: source supporting_context entries with doc_part text that resolve inside metadata.text_doc_ids;require one to four texts
exact_support_population.population_requirements: exactly one resolvable metadata.table_id;nonempty source-provided text distractor pool;support parts limited to table and text;at least one exact gold row-text pair;no image support or image requirement
exact_support_population.qualification: one aggregate-only qualification reports per-split per-family eligible counts and connected-component capacities without item IDs text answers support values or action

metrics_and_decisions.A_hold_promotion: sum_integer_utility(E5-E0)>0 and ties-excluded exact one-sided gain-vs-harm binomial reference tail<=0.10
metrics_and_decisions.A_hold_reality_primary: sum_integer_utility(E5-RAW)>0 and sum_integer_utility(E5-HippoRAG)>0;each comparison strictly positive in every one of the three topology families;each aggregate ties-excluded exact one-sided gain-vs-harm binomial reference tail<=0.10
metrics_and_decisions.M_search_L5: only after promotion;sum_integer_utility(E5-E0)>0;all three family delta sums nonnegative with at least two strictly positive;ties-excluded exact one-sided gain-vs-harm binomial reference tail<=0.10
metrics_and_decisions.primary_metric: binary exact-support linear-gain nDCG@5 over atomic row and text nodes
secondary_metrics: exact connected gold row-text pair recovered in top-five

no_gate_loop_and_execution.formal_network: denied after source and runtime acquisition
no_gate_loop_and_execution.maximum_useful_parallelism: staged bounded execution: one cross-encoder worker on physical GPU1;one MiniLM worker on physical GPU0 after any asset canary;HippoRAG exclusive stage maximum four processes two per GPU;never unbounded 3*n processes
terminal_conditions: pinned source identity or aggregate exact-support capacity failure
frozen local runtime or model asset identity failure before formal item action
one-shot formal implementation or action failure
valid non-promotion or valid primary failure
